explanation: I found no match in Mathlib. The theorem describes the Galois group of a quartic through its cubic resolvent: the group has transitive label 0 or 2 (degree-4 index) exactly when f is irreducible of degree 4 and the resolvent has a unique root in F. Its content comes from the library's own definitions (HasGaloisLabel, TransitiveGroupIndex, quarticD4Spec) and from other library lemmas. I searched Mathlib for "resolvent", "quartic", "cubic resolvent" and "TransitiveGroup" (case-insensitive) and got no hits, so Mathlib has no theory of Galois groups of quartics or of cubic resolvents.
